title: Outfits & fashion
about: Clothes date a photo to the decade better than almost anything else, especially women's hemlines and hair, men's hats and lapels, and children's clothes. Quiz images come from the Wikipedia fashion-by-decade articles (photographs, catalogues and fashion plates of the time).
sheet: Floor-length skirts, S-bend corset 'pigeon chest', high lace collars, huge hats with feathers
Three-piece suits, high stiff collars, bowler/top hat/boater, moustaches
Children in sailor suits; everyone wears a hat outdoors
Hobble skirts, ankles appear ~1915, wide hats; WW1 nurse/work uniforms

Knee-length drop-waist dresses (1925+), bobbed hair, cloche hats
